question: En mieloma múltiple, ¿cuántos fármacos distintos se están probando o se probaron en ensayos?

attempts.query:
WITH names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_chembl_id, n FROM (
    SELECT m.parent_chembl_id, lower(m.pref_name) AS n FROM chembl.molecule_dictionary m
    UNION
    SELECT m.parent_chembl_id, lower(s.synonyms) FROM chembl.molecule_dictionary m
    JOIN chembl.molecule_synonyms s ON s.chembl_id = m.chembl_id
  ) x WHERE n IS NOT NULL AND length(n) >= 5
),
trials AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT nct_id FROM aact.browse_conditions WHERE downcase_mesh_term = 'multiple myeloma'
),
tnames AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT lower(i.name) AS n FROM aact.interventions i JOIN trials t ON t.nct_id = i.nct_id
  UNION
  SELECT lower(o.name) FROM aact.intervention_other_names o JOIN trials t ON t.nct_id = o.nct_id
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT nm.parent_chembl_id)
FROM tnames tn JOIN names nm ON tn.n = nm.n
